factual_and_methodological.summary: NBIM primary evidence confirms NOK22.683tn fund value at 30 Jun 2026, the 72.1/25.8/1.6/0.5 asset allocation, and 6,899 shareholder meetings / 75,757 resolutions in 1H26. The dossier preserves the formal delegation chain from Norwegian public institutions to Norges Bank/NBIM and does not turn broad minority ownership into direct corporate command.

editorial_publication_readiness.opening: Direct mechanism-led opening; no generic sophistication claims or product-process narration.
editorial_publication_readiness.headings: Headings advance the actor-specific mechanism, constraints, contrary evidence and revision conditions.
editorial_publication_readiness.language_localization: EN and PT-BR are semantically aligned; PT-BR technical prose was localized before approval.
editorial_publication_readiness.cohesion: Argument moves from rights/capability through transmission, constraints and evidence that would revise the assessment.
editorial_publication_readiness.template_meta_qa: No prompt, QA-process, schema, renderer or roadmap leakage detected.

contextual_depth.summary: The dossier distinguishes legal rights, operating capability, transmission, substitutability and institutional constraints rather than relying on scale or reputation.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: At least two analytical tables, one quantitative chart, one causal flow and one mind map in both locales.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: Visuals encode sourced quantities or mechanisms defended in prose and are not combined into a synthetic power score.

contrary_evidence: Global listed markets have many alternative investors, so GPFG is structurally important through scale and persistence rather than monopoly.
Other institutional shareholders vote and engage with the same companies, limiting attribution of governance outcomes to NBIM alone.
limitations: Market value changes combine returns, currency effects and inflows and must not be read as new capital allocation one-for-one.
System-wide governance effects are harder to attribute than the fund's documented ownership rights and voting activity.
notes: Dedicated single-actor Strategic Actors dossier. Primary-source factual core, controlled taxonomy, bilingual parity and visual evidence reviewed; no public bundle for this ID at approval time.

en.title: NBIM / GPFG: public savings, delegated management and persistent global ownership
en.deck: Norway's GPFG converts petroleum-derived public wealth into diversified global ownership through a formal delegation chain. Its structural role comes from persistent capital and shareholder rights, not direct state control of portfolio companies.
en.regime: Large public savings are invested globally through a formal delegation chain with recurring but bounded shareholder rights.
en.key_risk: Conflating public ownership of the fund with political direction of individual portfolio companies overstates control.
watch: fund value relative to global markets
en.search_text: NBIM GPFG strategic actor Norway sovereign fund public savings delegated management voting global ownership

pt-BR.title: NBIM / GPFG: poupança pública, gestão delegada e propriedade global persistente
pt-BR.deck: O GPFG norueguês converte riqueza pública ligada ao petróleo em propriedade financeira global diversificada por uma cadeia formal de delegação. Seu papel vem de capital persistente e direitos acionários, não de controle estatal direto das investidas.
pt-BR.regime: Grande poupança pública é investida globalmente por uma cadeia formal de delegação com direitos acionários recorrentes, porém limitados.
pt-BR.key_risk: Confundir propriedade pública do fundo com direção política de empresas individuais exagera o controle.
watch: valor do fundo em relação aos mercados globais
pt-BR.search_text: NBIM GPFG ator estratégico Noruega fundo soberano poupança pública gestão delegada voto propriedade global

publication.selection_rationale: NBIM/GPFG is an active Strategic Actors record with two documented structural relations but previously appeared only in comparative research.
